evidence.title: tl;dv - AI Meeting Notetaker for Zoom, Google Meet & Teams

name: tl;dv
summary: AI notetaker that records and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet and Teams meetings.
description: tl;dv captures Zoom, Google Meet and Teams meetings with or without a bot, then writes transcripts and summaries in 30+ languages, logs CRM updates, drafts follow-ups and answers questions across many calls. 5,000+ integrations, sales coaching clips and aggregated reports; SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and EU hosting, with no model training on your calls.
contains: records Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls, bot or bot-free
5,000+ integrations with CRM updates and drafted follow-ups
SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, EU-hosted data, no model training on calls
